n0:createSxmlObject.n0:source: <VIEW xmlns="http://xmlns.oracle.com/ku" version="1.0"> <SCHEMA>%USER_NAME%</SCHEMA> <NAME>VW_ESTADO_CUENTA</NAME> <DEFAULT_COLLATION>USING_NLS_COMP</DEFAULT_COLLATION> <COL_LIST> <COL_LIST_ITEM> <NAME>ID_CUOTA</NAME> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> </COL_LIST_ITEM> <COL_LIST_ITEM> <NAME>ID_CASA</NAME> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> </COL_LIST_ITEM> <COL_LIST_ITEM> <NAME>NUMERO_CASA</NAME> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> </COL_LIST_ITEM> <COL_LIST_ITEM> <NAME>CONCEPTO</NAME> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> </COL_LIST_ITEM> <COL_LIST_ITEM> <NAME>PERIODO</NAME> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> </COL_LIST_ITEM> <COL_LIST_ITEM> <NAME>MONTO_TOTAL</NAME> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> </COL_LIST_ITEM> <COL_LIST_ITEM> <NAME>TOTAL_PAGADO</NAME> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> </COL_LIST_ITEM> <COL_LIST_ITEM> <NAME>SALDO_PENDIENTE</NAME> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> </COL_LIST_ITEM> <COL_LIST_ITEM> <NAME>FECHA_EMISION</NAME> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> </COL_LIST_ITEM> <COL_LIST_ITEM> <NAME>FECHA_VENCIMIENTO</NAME> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> </COL_LIST_ITEM> <COL_LIST_ITEM> <NAME>ESTADO</NAME> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> </COL_LIST_ITEM> </COL_LIST> <ANNOTATION_LIST></ANNOTATION_LIST> <SUBQUERY>SELECT cu.id_cuota, cu.id_casa, c.numero_casa, cu.concepto, cu.periodo, cu.monto_total, NVL(pagos.total_pagado, 0) AS total_pagado, (cu.monto_total - NVL(pagos.total_pagado, 0)) AS saldo_pendiente, cu.fecha_emision, cu.fecha_vencimiento, cu.estado FROM CUOTA cu JOIN CASA c ON cu.id_casa = c.id_casa LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id_cuota, SUM(monto_pagado) AS total_pagado FROM PAGO WHERE estado = 'VALIDO' GROUP BY id_cuota ) pagos ON cu.id_cuota = pagos.id_cuota</SUBQUERY> </VIEW>
